title: Power On
subtitle: filter house · the low-pass opens on a logistic curve
statement: A disco loop wakes up behind a closed filter. The filter opens on an S-curve, slow, then all at once, and the machine is on.
intro: The first track of the night: a warm room, a disco loop through the wall, and then the power comes on.

sections.name: Boot
sections.intent: A DJ-friendly start: kick and off-beat hats; the bass arrives half-filtered at bar 9.
moves: Kick and hats only for 8 bars so a DJ can mix in.

sections.name: Warm Up
sections.intent: The clap and open hats join; the loop starts, buried at 400 Hz.
moves: The disco loop enters behind a closed filter.

sections.name: Filter Up
sections.intent: The loop's low-pass opens along a logistic curve, 400 Hz to 7 kHz.
sections.feeling: The lights coming on one row at a time.
moves: Riser in the last 4 bars; the kick steps out for the last bar.

sections.name: Power On
sections.intent: Full loop with a phaser, the lead says the handshake, a synth choir on top.
moves: Lead: F, C, F, A-flat: root, fifth, octave, minor third.

sections.name: Brownout
sections.intent: Kick and bass out; the loop sinks to 900 Hz and the phaser slows.
sections.feeling: Power dips, the room holds its breath.

sections.name: Power On II
sections.intent: Back with organ stabs on the off-beats and the lead an octave up.

sections.name: Shutdown
sections.intent: The loop closes again; the last 8 bars are drums only for the next mix.
sections.feeling: The machine winding down, still humming.

layers.name: Kick
layers.description: A 909-style kick: a sine swept from 230 Hz to F, a click and light drive.
layers.purpose: The pulse; every other part ducks under it.

layers.name: Clap
layers.description: A clap on 2 and 4, darker than take 1.

instrument.name: Drum kit
instrument.description: clap, hat, kick, open, ride, rim, shaker

layers.name: Hats
layers.description: Metallic hats from six band-limited square oscillators (the 808 recipe): short closed ticks and off-beat open hats, almost no noise.
layers.purpose: The tick of the groove, kept small.

instrument.name: Drum kit
instrument.description: clap, hat, kick, open, ride, rim, shaker

layers.name: Disco loop
layers.description: The chord loop (Fm9, D-flat maj7, E-flat add9, Cm7) chopped on a Euclidean E(7,16) rhythm, through a sweeping low-pass and a phaser.
layers.purpose: The hook. The whole track is this loop being switched on.
layers.math: cutoff = 400 · (7000/400)^σ(10(u − ½)) over Filter Up; chop = E(7,16)

instrument.name: Supersaw
instrument.description: Seven detuned saws per note, spread wide, through an enveloped low-pass.

layers.name: Disco bass
layers.description: Octave-jumping disco bass on each chord's root: saw, square and sub into a ladder filter that snaps on every note. Since take 3 it rides above the warm bass, high-passed at 220 Hz: the bite and the talk, not the weight.

instrument.name: Mono Synth
instrument.description: Saw, square and sub oscillators, glide, vibrato and an enveloped resonant filter.

layers.name: Talky lead
layers.description: Square and saw with glide and vibrato, a little like a talk box: it says the album's handshake motif, F, C, F, A-flat.
layers.math: handshake = root, fifth, octave, minor third (0, 7, 12, 15 semitones)

instrument.name: Mono Synth
instrument.description: Saw, square and sub oscillators, glide, vibrato and an enveloped resonant filter.

layers.name: House organ
layers.description: Off-beat organ stabs: drawbar-like partials with a percussive decay.

instrument.name: House Organ
instrument.description: Sine partials 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8 with a percussive decay and a key click.

layers.name: Brownout pad
layers.description: Slow supersaw chords that fill the room while the power dips.

instrument.name: Supersaw
instrument.description: Seven detuned saws per note, spread wide, through an enveloped low-pass.

layers.name: Synth choir
layers.description: A synth choir: four drifting, vibrato-ed saw singers per note through five choir formants, each chord walking its own vowels. No breath noise.
layers.purpose: Fills the top with voices instead of hiss.

instrument.name: Synth Choir
instrument.description: An ensemble of drifting, vibrato-ed saws per note through five choir formants; tones, no noise.

layers.name: Warm bass
layers.description: Moog-style: saw, detuned pulse and a triangle sub into an overdriven ladder, then tape warmth.
layers.purpose: The warm foundation: it owns everything below about 250 Hz.

instrument.name: Warm Bass (Moog-style)
instrument.description: Saw, detuned pulse and triangle sub into an overdriven ladder that follows the note, then tape warmth.

layers.name: Transitions
layers.description: Risers, reversed crashes, impacts and downlifters at every turn.

instrument.name: Transition FX
instrument.description: Noise risers, downlifters, impacts, crashes, reversed crashes and sub drops.

layers.name: Machine voice (vocoder)
layers.description: The voice through a 28-band vocoder on a saw carrier at the sung notes: the machine waking behind the filter, the hook "Hello, world", and the brownout.

instrument.name: Electric Bat voice
instrument.description: The project's singing synthesizer: lyrics to phonemes, a human performance, autotune, then production.

layers.name: Voice (after the reboot)
layers.description: The same hook after the reboot, half human: the sung voice with doubles, blended with the vocoder.

instrument.name: Electric Bat voice
instrument.description: The project's singing synthesizer: lyrics to phonemes, a human performance, autotune, then production.

layers.name: Robots
layers.description: A machine booting up under the DJ intro, a power core spooling into the drop, a droid answering the hook, then a real power-down and reboot in the Brownout.

instrument.name: Robot rack
instrument.description: Machines from the batsynth robot library (servos, droids, modems, coils, turbines, alarms, clocks).

lanes.name: tension (plan)
lanes.description: How tense each section is meant to feel.

annotations.text: Filter Up: the loop's low-pass begins its S-curve.
Brownout: kick and bass out, the loop sinks.
Drums only from here: mix out.

motifs.how: stated on the lead, answered by a falling line

lyrics.text: Through the wall I hear a party,
bass coming up through the floor,
say it back, say it back to me,
now I'm on, I'm on, I'm on.
say it back, say it back to me,
now I'm on, I'm on, I'm on.
say it back, say it back to me,
and the whole room sings hello.

lyrics_take4.text: I can feel the heat of a thousand hands.
Wake me up, I'm ready to begin.
Hello, world, I'm awake in the wire, say it back, say it back to me.
Hello, world, and the world says hello, hello, hello.
